notes.title: Up All Night Version 1.25 - Achievements Fix
notes.notes:
Howdy players,

We hope you've been enjoying the latest update, which includes [i]Rumination[/i]; a glimpse into Nick's future after the events of [i]Up All Night[/i].

Unfortunately, with the update we failed to catch a simple error -- one that prevented achievements from unlocking.

We have addressed the issue; though in order to unlock all achievements you have collected thus far, you will need to skip through to an ending in [i]Up All Night[/i] (any ending will do). Upon completion of an ending, all achievements you have gathered throughout the game should unlock. Thank goodness for the skip button feature!

If you have any other issues, we urge you to reach out to our team... we will always do our best to help.

Thanks for playing... and as always,

Stay fiendish!

notes.title: New Content Update - Up All Night: Rumination
notes.notes:
Howdy all,

We come bearing huge news on the Fiendish Fiction front!

You may have noticed an update to Up All Night. This recent renovation incorporates a free new story expansion, Up All Night: Rumination, accessible through the gallery after completing the ending/achievement ‘Last Man Standing.’

Years after the events of Up All Night, Nick Torres remains haunted by the ghosts of his past. Seeking help -- or at least solace -- he reaches out to licensed therapist Patricia Rathburn for guidance.

Much to her dismay, Nick's presence proves a harrowing reminder of Patricia's own inner demons... but can she see past her clouded judgement to help this troubled young man?

Unfortunately, therapy can't fix everything.

Up All Night: Rumination incorporates mature themes including physical and psychological trauma, abusive relationships, suicidal ideation, and visual and written depictions of gore.

Rumination can be considered an interlude between Up All Night and its future sequel, currently in pre-production.

[list]
[*] NEW FEATURES:
[*] Six Nick poses with over 20 expressions
[*] One unlockable illustration
[*] Original soundtrack
[*] 10,000+ words
[*] Three endings
[/list]

With this massive update comes a few additional changes:

[b]Removal of autosaves[/b] - due to Rumination having its own unique UI, the autosave function caused major bugs during testing in both the original Up All Night game, and Rumination. To address the issue we elected to remove the autosave function completely. Please remember to save frequently!

[b]Current Up All Night saves/loads may be non-functioning or bring up an error screen.[/b] We deeply apologize for this inconvenience, as we have been unable to circumvent this issue. We highly recommend that if you come across this error, restart your current game. The skip feature should help you reach where you left off in no time!

If you run into any additional issues or are otherwise having trouble with the game, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We will always do our best to help!

We’ll wrap it up with a little sharing of gratitude: thank you all so much for your continued support. We have been absolutely overwhelmed by the positive feedback we have received on Up All Night, and can’t wait to bring you more fun, unique content. Keep your eyes open… we’ve got plenty in the pipeline!

Until next time,

Stay fiendish!

notes.title: Version 1.01 - Achievements Fix
notes.notes:
Howdy players, we hope you've been enjoying your time with Nick at Aspen Lodge.

Last night, we uploaded a new build that fixes achievements not unlocking properly, as well as a few very minor graphical effects that did not affect gameplay. All of your achievements will unlock at the end of any ending, so if you have already played through the entire game, run through one more time to get those synced up. Existing saves may reload to a few lines prior to your original save point and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

That's all for now, and until next time...

Stay fiendish!
